text:
maya.peopleops: Quick sync — candidate Gomez (Data Eng) visiting Thu. Flight lands 08:45, loop 10:30-15:00. Need: visitor badge, parking QR, loaner laptop (Windows preferred), dietary note (vegan), arrival SMS.

alex.recruiter: I have candidate phone ending 7789. They asked for a quiet coding room. I'll handle arrival SMS + stipend details.

ben.it: We have one Surface laptop available. Full corp image needs 12h; can do minimal image (VPN + browser + vscode) in 5h. Disk encryption and MDM on first boot.

maya.peopleops: Minimal image ok. Ben pls label device and write the temporary Wi-Fi creds on the welcome slip.

taylors-ops: Parking: Visitor Lot A, gate code 8821#. Badge pick-up at 3rd floor desk, show ID. I'll print NDA + loaner agreement and GF snack.

nina.hiringmgr: Panel: 10:30 intro, 11:00 coding exercise, 12:30 lunch, 13:30 system design, 14:30 debrief. If flight delayed >45m we'll shift lunch and run intro remote.

flight-bot: Flight DL410 arriving 08:45. Status: on-time. Reminder set for 07:45 to prep badge/forms.

alex.recruiter: Drafting SMS now. Will include address (12 Redwood Plaza), parking code, host phone (+1-555-0202), and Concur reimbursement link. Won't include interview content. Will paste copy here.

maya.peopleops: Please cc panel leads on logistics only. Ben/Taylor, confirm forms + loaner ready 2h before arrival.

ben.it: Confirmed. Device reserved and will be on desk with loaner form.

taylors-ops: Forms printed. I'll also have a pen and sanitizer.

maya.peopleops: Thanks all. Alex paste the sent SMS/email here so I can add to candidate file. :thumbsup:
